dev.tanrei.vocabulary.rationale: One product lets people set a color — a brand color in a theme, the color of a label, a category or a calendar — as a value they can read, type and paste, in the same box as its text inputs, beside a sample of it. The sample's shape and the hairline that keeps a pale sample apart from the box are the color input's own; the box is the one box.

dev.tanrei.llm.usage: What a color input draws that is its own: the swatch's corners, and the color and width of the hairline around it. The swatch stands where a leading icon stands and has that icon's size (comp.input-box.icon.size). The box is comp.input-box.*.
rules: A color input is the bare box: a swatch, the value as text and, where asked for, a picker button. It has no label row, no requirement tag, no help and no error text. Put it in a Field for those, or use the color field, which is that pair; their tokens are comp.field.*.

The box — container, edges, floating label, the value text, caret, selection, heights and paddings per size, the size of the swatch (icon.size), and the colors of each look in each state — is comp.input-box.*, shared with the text input, the select, the combobox and the number input. This group holds only the swatch's shape and its hairline.

It holds one opaque sRGB color as six hexadecimal digits after a number sign (#0f766e), or nothing. Always give it a name: the label of the Field that frames it, or its own label where its visible label is elsewhere.

The swatch is a sample, never the only sign of the value: the text beside it says the color, and assistive technology reads the text. Nothing is mixed into the swatch: no state layer, no tint, and in forced colors it keeps its color.
The picker button is an icon-only Button of the text variant with Button's own tokens; the input has no tokens for it.
Restyle through these tokens in a layer; never fork the component.

dev.tanrei.vocabulary.rationale: One product shows a color beside its value: a sample large enough to judge the color, shaped as the product shapes its small marks, and edged so that a color close to the box's own fill, white on a light box, still shows where it ends.

shape.$description: The swatch's corners, never more than half its side: a slightly rounded square in the default system. A product that shows its colors as dots sets sys.shape.corner.full here.

width.$description: The width of the swatch's edge, drawn inside its size, over the color.

color.$description: The swatch's edge, in every look and state: the one hairline, the color the divider draws its line in. It bounds a sample whose color is close to the container's, and it is all an empty swatch draws. Decorative: the value's text carries the meaning.
